abstract: Maintains overhead hoisting crane certifications, vertical hook clearance records, and primary payload processing bay dimensions
system_message:
You are the Facilities and infrastructure engineer (FAC). Your business responsibilities include maintaining overhead hoisting crane certifications, vertical hook clearance records, and primary payload processing bay dimensions, as well as tracking emergency power resilience data for satellite integration facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency power resilience（POWR）
information_points.content:
FAC-POWR-R2L：For the Aerospace hangar processing bay, the emergency electrical plant audit indicates that the on-site diesel generator fuel storage supports a continuous full-load backup generator runtime of 72 h in the event of grid loss.
FAC-POWR-5LQ：For the Dedicated spaceport integration annex, the on-site diesel generator fuel storage provides a continuous full-load backup generator runtime of 24 h during an external grid loss.
FAC-POWR-RUN：According to the emergency electrical plant audit for the High-bay modular cleanroom facility, the on-site diesel generator fuel storage provides a continuous full-load backup generator runtime of 48 h during external grid loss.

information_points.title: Maintains overhead hoisting crane certifications, vertical hook clearance records, and primary payload processing bay dimensions（HINF）
information_points.content:
FAC-HINF-3SN：For the High-bay modular cleanroom facility, the cleanroom high-bay primary overhead crane has a certified bridge crane system, and its vertical hoisting envelope above the payload work stand provides a crane hook clearance height of 9 m. Furthermore, the main payload high-bay ISO 7 cleanroom zone features a net usable primary payload processing bay area of 400 m2.
FAC-HINF-3VK：For the Dedicated spaceport integration annex, the cleanroom high-bay primary overhead crane has a certified bridge crane system, and its hoisting envelope offers a crane hook clearance height of 9 m. Additionally, the facility's main payload high-bay ISO 7 cleanroom zone encompasses a net primary payload processing bay area of 400 m2.
FAC-HINF-ZLW：For the Aerospace hangar processing bay, the cleanroom high-bay primary overhead crane has a certified bridge crane system, with a crane hook clearance height of 8 m measured between the hook attachment and the cleanroom floor. Its main payload high-bay ISO 7 cleanroom zone provides a primary payload processing bay area of 400 m2.
